name: 🏙️ CityScape
desc:
Welcome to CityScape!

Build your very own city with 800 🏙️ Buildings and 🛣️ Roads, on a plot size of 📐512x512 studs!

Your only limit is your imagination!

Please leave a 👍 Like and hit the 🔔 Notification Bell and join the group to help support CityScape's continued development. (UPDATED WEEKLY EVERY FRIDAY!)

⚠️ It is possible that some bugs and glitches may occur. Please report any you come across via the server linked on the Sphyix Studios group! 

Version 0.2.2a
